_doc: STYLE PACKS — the swappable font layer, cloned EXACTLY from the creator's 'Font Pack' CapCut mockup (2026-07-31). 3 launch packs (Editorial · Playful · Butter), all in the kit. Each element (headline/takeover/caption/thought_bubble/accent_caption) has its font + size + tracking(letter-spacing) + line_height + y(up+), per pack. The LAYOUT is the pattern; fonts/sizes are per-pack. Engine reads this: pick a pack -> apply. Both build modes (kinetic HF overlay + native CapCut) use it. Roles: main=headline+takeover(usually), accent=thought_bubble+accent_caption(the personality font), caption=read-along(quiet). Sizes are per-font on purpose (accent runs 2 lines on some, 3 on others). Drop shadow = a legibility FLOOR (always ON for rendered text over footage; a pack TUNES its value via welldone.text_shadow, but can never remove it — resolved by stylepack.text_shadow()). See style-pack-architecture memory, font-picking-guardrails.md, fonts.json.

read_along_style._doc: USER picks per reel. karaoke_line_build = words build in place (fixed positions) with a MOVING sweep; single_word_snap = one word at a time, centered, replacing.

captions._accent_caption_doc: Accent captions ALWAYS appear karaoke line-build (moving sweep, word-by-word, fixed positions) — never snap, never static block (locked).

highlight._doc: The accent-color highlight on the currently-swept word is OPTIONAL. It is ALWAYS available, but the user can keep captions plain white (no color).

accent_color._doc: Accent = the CLIENT's chosen color, never an imposed default (the creator: not my butter yellow). Each pack sets its own accent; a buyer overrides per-brand. Unset falls back to WHITE (neutral), never a yellow. the creator's personal butter #FFFFC2 is passed explicitly on her own reels only.

Editorial.vibe: literary + editorial (green/pink/cream · Playfair · Poppins chrome · Prosecco accent)

Playful.vibe: brutalist playful (color-blocks + ink borders + hard offset shadows · Soup Du Jour · Ugly Dave · Noto)
Playful._playful_default_note: Solid Soup Du Jour hook in mustard #F5C518 + white solid subhead; HOLLOW Soup Du Jour is takeover-only (large, one word per line). Inspired by a mustard-yellow reference reel; shade shifted so it is the creator's own, not a copy.

licensing: SETTLED MODEL (2026-08-15): the engine ships NO licensed font file. OFL fonts (Playfair/Poppins/Noto Sans Adlam/Inter/DM Sans) ship bundled. The licensed pack fonts — Prosecco (PeachCreme, PAID) / Soup Du Jour (Pizzadude.dk, 'distribution prohibited') / Bloop (personal-use) — are EXCLUDED from ship (make-ship.sh) and resolve BY NAME from the buyer's own CapCut (product/capcut_userfonts.py; CapCut Pro carries them). check-ship.sh §8 scans font BINARIES and fails on any licensed leak. Geomanist / Opera Cake were the discarded Vintage pack's fonts and are not used by any launch pack. If a buyer's CapCut can't resolve one, product/capcut_font_doctor.py reports it and lets them hand-map a file. Helvetica Neue = system, never bundled.
_playful_font_note: Playful mixes TWO Soup Du Jour variants, both display-named 'Soup Du Jour' in CapCut (disambiguate by FILE / resource_id, never by name): the SOLID variant (subfamily 'Solid', resource_id 7525297864323435777) = SoupDuJour.ttf sets the HEADLINE and the THOUGHT_BUBBLE; the HOLLOW/outline variant (subfamily 'Regular', resource_id 7527233572441181457) = SoupDuJourHollow.ttf sets the TAKEOVER only. CAPTION, ACCENT_CAPTION and the subhead are Ugly Dave (UglyDaveAlternates.otf); Noto Sans Adlam is only their bundled fallback. None of these font files ship: they resolve by name from the creator's own CapCut.
